05 / INSPECT THE WORK

Workspace and dashboard canvas

The implementation includes dataset upload and editing, statistics tools, chart and table nodes, a draggable dashboard canvas, and saved dashboard routes. A Flask backend connects data processing and AI-assisted analysis with the Next.js interface.

This is an exploratory codebase. The repository provides the implementation for review; no live deployment or performance result is asserted.
